Done — I built and wired up a playable top-down creature collector RPG.

What’s included:
- 60 species total, each with 3 variations (180 creature entries in the data set)
- Top-down exploration with WASD movement
- Wild creature encounters
- Capture, strike, guard, switch, scan, and travel actions
- Quest loop and party management
- Bestiary panel with creature list
- Browser-based playable build with no external dependencies

Run/view it here:
- http://localhost:3000/

Controls:
- WASD: move
- Space: attack
- E: capture
- Buttons in the UI also work

Assumptions:
- Kept it lightweight and self-contained as a browser canvas game for easy running in a static local server.
- Used simple stylized shapes instead of external art assets to keep the build portable and playable immediately.
